manual_visual_review.observation: 390 px 侧栏下 123.456 μm 完整；失败卡片与上一条有效测量说明明确。
真实撤销后旧达标卡消失，数量降为 1 / 2；底部显示最近有效测量 123.456 μm。
全部撤销后数量为 0 / 2；卡片消失，底部显示本视场暂无有效测量记录。
重做恢复 2 / 2，未重复弹出旧达标卡，底部最近有效值为 20.000 μm。
实际减计按钮使总数降为 3 / 4，旧达标卡消失。
改变目标后显示 3 / 4，旧卡片消失，150% Qt 缩放下数值与控件完整。
200% Qt 缩放下真实撤销同步显示 123.456 μm、最近有效测量、1 / 2；卡片消失。
从最终录像解码抽帧，显示全部撤销后的 0 / 2 和空记录提示。

limitations: No Windows desktop, Windows font, real SDK, Microview camera, Excel, or frozen installer acceptance in this visual run.
QT_SCALE_FACTOR exercises Qt layout/raster scaling; virtual offscreen screen is not physical display, taskbar/titlebar, or mixed-monitor DPI switching.
123.456, 20.000 and 22.000 micrometre records are explicit validation fixtures; no numerical detection accuracy claim.
no_complete_crossing is injected at the existing controller rejection boundary to inspect its real feedback publication path.
100-cycle checks retire fields and deliver status signals; they verify stable geometry, not scene-motion detector accuracy, camera latency, or throughput.
Video captures Qt window changes and is encoded at 15 fps; capture timestamps are preserved, and video duration is not a benchmark.
Raw screenshots, videos, profiles and per-case logs are local ignored artifacts; this manifest records their hashes.
